name: Management of Transportation Infrastructure Systems
description: Transportation infrastructure components; deterioration phenomena; effect of external factors like environment, traffic loading, material properties on deterioration mechanisms; evaluation techniques to evaluate damage: destructive, nondestructive; performance models: development, calibration; infrastructure management systems; serviceability of condition and safety; decision making and optimization techniques applied to infrastructure management; life cycle cost analysis techniques.
